fact: INSEED held a 10-17 August 2026 retreat to finalise methodological documents, cartography tools and questionnaires for the fifth census (RGPH-5), planned for September 2027 with tablet (CAPI) collection.

The government and INSEED officially launched RGPH-5 on 5 June 2026; about 60% of the funding still to be mobilised was already secured, a pilot phase starts September 2026 and general enumeration is planned for September 2027.
INSEED held a 13-24 April 2026 workshop training census cartography agents on digital GIS tools ahead of RGPH-5, planned for 2027.
The INSEED microdata archive lists the Recensement General de la Population et de l'Habitat 2017 (data years 2017-2018), added 24 October 2025.
The INSEED microdata archive lists the EHCVM 2024 household living-conditions survey, added 12 May 2026.
The INSEED microdata archive lists the MICS 2022 survey, added 24 October 2025.

INSEED released version 1.0 (April 2026) of the EHCVM 2024 data and documentation, a nationally representative survey of 5,487 households fielded May to November 2024, in its open microdata catalogue.
